clues.it: Fabio era accanto a un albero di Natale e nel Giardino Innevato.
clues.en: Fabio was beside a Christmas tree and in the Snowy Garden.

clues.it: Luca era l'unica persona su un mucchio di letterine e a nord di Bruno.
clues.en: Luca was the only person on a pile of letters and north of Bruno.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a un camino.

clues.en: Dario was in the Snowy Garden.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a una sedia a dondolo.
clues.en: Elena was beside a rocking chair.

clues.it: Marta era nella 1ª colonna e nella 9ª riga.
clues.en: Marta was in the 1st column and in the 9th row.

steps.it: Solo Nino può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 8ª è sua.
steps.en: Nino is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Fabio's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 2nd, column 4th.

steps.en: Luca is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 6th is theirs.

steps.en: Anna is the only one who can be in the 8th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 7th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 1st.
